snippet.title: SOMNIUS — Official Gameplay Trailer | 6-Player Co-op
snippet.description:
Wishlist SOMNIUS on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882630/SOMNIUS/

Watch the official gameplay trailer for SOMNIUS, a chaotic first-person co-op extraction game for 1–6 players. Explore collapsing dreams, turn furniture into ammunition, and rescue the Dreamer before the world burns away.

Your vacuum gun is your weapon, your tool, and probably the reason your friend is flying across the room.

Every object comes with a choice: fire it at a monster or launch it into the portal to add precious seconds to your team's shared timer. Gather supplies, drain the evil energy sealing away the Dreamer, and get them back to the portal before time runs out.

• Play solo or team up with up to five friends.
• Explore procedurally generated dreams filled with strange rooms and dangerous creatures.
• Vacuum up objects and fire them back at enemies.
• Feed the portal to buy more time for everyone.
• Rescue fallen teammates and improvise with physics.
• Talk through proximity voice chat, but remember, monsters can hear you too.

One shared timer. Six players. What could possibly go wrong?

Developed by STFGames, creators of Stone Simulator - Just Be a Rock.
Platform: PC / Steam

Learn more on our Steam Page
